description.value: Il Covo Trattoria is a family-run authentic Italian restaurant located in Victoria's historic James Bay neighbourhood, housed in a 112-year-old heritage building steps from the Inner Harbour. The restaurant holds the Ospitalità Italiana seal from the Italian Chamber of Commerce, certifying its authenticity, with an owner originally from Genova who has been bringing Italian flavours to Victoria since 1999. Cyclists can dine on northern Italian classics and family recipes, with the option of eating al fresco in the garden patio.

Takeout is explicitly offered by phone. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Il Covo is a well-established, notable restaurant in a high-traffic tourist area near the Inner Harbour, making it a plausible dinner stop for touring cyclists; however, no bike parking or cycling-specific amenities are confirmed, and it is dinner-only, limiting daytime utility. A site visit or direct contact would clarify whether bike parking exists nearby.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant explicitly warns that UberEats has falsely listed them; takeout is available only by calling the restaurant directly.
